payload.description: The systems the business layer harvested that serve customers and the books, with the connections drafted from the process map and the pattern library, and the estate systems they reach. Every connection carries its integration style and names its pattern in the inspector; the operations chain is its own drawing. Proposed throughout, so an owner has something to confirm or strike.

flows.description: A card presented at a merchant, authorized or declined inside the scheme timeout. The tightest latency budget in the estate, and the reason the screening call has a circuit breaker rather than a retry.
flows.name: Card Authorization

flows.description: A cardholder disputes a transaction. Raised in the contact center, handled in the vendor platform, settled back through the ledger.
flows.name: Dispute and Chargeback

flows.description: The monthly supervisory return. Entirely batch, and the only flow whose deadline is external and non-negotiable.
flows.name: Regulatory Return

payload.title: The Harvested Estate, Connected
